# Operational Efficiency Improvement Plan

This document details critical actions for enhancing operational performance.

*   Optimize the cash flow urgently.
*   Review the cash flow urgently.
*   Update the teller performance urgently.
*   Investigate the branch efficiency quarterly.
*   Investigate the teller performance based on audit.
